target_customer: Small and medium delivery and home service businesses and independent drivers who need to plan multi stop routes
problem: Small fleets and gig drivers plan stops by hand or with enterprise tools that are expensive and slow to set up; Zeo offers simple route optimisation with driver tracking and proof of delivery.
business_model: Freemium SaaS with paid per driver or per delivery plans for the mobile app and Zeo Fleet web dashboard
product_category: Route optimisation and last mile delivery software

founders.name: Kshitij Dixit
prior_employers: Jio (product lead for mutual fund and digital gold platforms)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page bio; also built a co-working space aggregation platform.

founders.name: Ritesh Singh
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page with no background.

competitors.name: OptimoRoute
competitors.what: Route and schedule planning software for mobile workforces such as delivery drivers and field technicians
competitors.traction_then: More than 800 customers in over 20 countries, about 90 percent in the US
competitors.funding_then: 6.5M Series A led by Prelude Ventures, announced February 2020

technical_complexity.rationale: Route optimisation is a known hard problem but solvable with existing solvers and map APIs; the work was mobile apps, mapping accuracy and driver workflow.

defensibility.rationale: Several established route planners already existed and the product was copyable; differentiation was price, speed of setup and a free tier.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent absorbed the wedge; the company's own comparison pages show Route4Me, Circuit, Optimo and Onfleet still competing years later.

market_need_then: E-commerce and local delivery volume was rising in 2020 and small couriers lacked affordable planning tools; no dated demand data was found in sources.

branding.domain_note: Uses zeorouteplanner.com, a descriptive domain; the legal entity is Expronto Technologies Inc per app store and G2 listings.

identity.visual_style: Standard SaaS marketing site with review badges
identity.voice_and_tone: Productivity and cost savings, self reported number one rated claims and testimonials

branding.community_and_virality: Claims of about 30,000 reviews and a 4.8 rating on its own site, which are self reported; large SEO blog and a Zeo versus competitors content series.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself found; the descriptive suffix Route Planner is generic though Zeo is distinctive.

outcome_analysis: Zeo is still active as a small team, with a driver app that reports over a million drivers and thousands of business customers, though these figures are self reported. It appears to have grown through product led and content marketing rather than large venture funding, since no priced rounds could be verified. No exit or shutdown was found. The story is a bootstrapped style niche tool in a crowded category.
notes: Funding unverified and not recorded as rounds: aggregators disagree (CB Insights about 150K total with latest Seed VC II in January 2022; Village 1.4M; Prospeo 1M in May 2020). Named backers across aggregators include Y Combinator, Soma Capital, Xylo Capital, Liquid 2 Ventures, Pioneer Fund and Jude Gomilla. Founder education was not found. Circuit, Route4Me and Onfleet are named by Zeo's own comparison pages but those pages are undated and were not used as competitor sources. Revenue of 2.3M for 2024 appears on an auto generated profile and is unverified.
